newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper drops but base metals ranged.
newsitem.headline: India copper drops but base metals ranged.

text.p: Copper prices dropped further but base metals were steady in a narrow price band on the local market on Friday, dealers said.
Copper prices extended losses on fresh selling following reports of price reductions announced by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd.
Ready copper slid by 25 rupees at 13,325 rupees per quintal after losing 150 rupees on Thursday.
Hindustan Copper Ltd. has cut copper rates by 1,000/4,000 rupees per tonne for the different grades for August.
Hindustan Zinc Ltd. has hiked zinc prices by 2,000 rupees per tonne for August, while leaving lead prices unchanged, Sharad Parikh, president of the Bombay Metals Exchange, said.
In the open market zinc prices remained steady at 8,400 rupees per quintal as traders, expecting Hindustan Zinc's price hike, had already discounted it as a factor, Parikh said.
Lead was quiet at 4,200 rupees, as was aluminium at 7,800 rupees, tin at 29,200 rupees and nickel at 34,300 rupees per quintal in limited activity.
Market sentiment at the close remained firm on reports of a firm tendency in the world market.
